groups.title: Find where your family comes from.
groups.intro: Free, and a good place to begin if you know a village name and not much more.

groups.title: Keep what your family knows.
groups.intro: The stories, voices and sayings that live only in memory, kept privately for the people who come next.

groups.title: Hold it, give it, walk it.
groups.intro: Objects made by named makers, and journeys with hosts who live in the places families come from.

groups.title: For schools and communities.
groups.intro: The same tools and the same people, for a whole class or association.

products.name: Trace your roots
products.line: Add the places your family has lived, generation by generation, and see them grow into a portrait of where you come from.
products.who: Anyone who knows even one place in their family's story.
steps: Add the places you know, one generation at a time.
Ask a relative to fill in the gaps.
Keep the portrait, or have it painted.
products.trust: Everything you type stays in your browser until you choose to keep it in your archive.

products.name: Places
products.line: Pages for the towns and regions families come from: their words, dishes, rituals and songs, added to by families themselves.

products.name: The Commons
products.line: One question every week about the words, dishes and rituals families carry. Read what others remember, and add yours.
products.who: Anyone curious about where their family's ways come from.
steps: Read this week's question.
Share a word, a dish or a memory.
A person reads it before it appears.
products.trust: Nothing appears until a person has read it, and you choose the name it is credited to.

products.name: Family archive
products.line: A private home for your family's stories, voice notes, photographs, sayings and letters, shared with the people you choose and passed on when you decide.
products.who: Families who want a grandparent's voice and stories kept, wherever everyone lives.
products.price: Free to begin. A Family plan with more room and a printed book is coming.
steps: Ask an elder one question a week.
Keep their voice note or your own words.
Share it, or leave it for later.
products.trust: Private by default. Never sold, never used for advertising, always yours to download.

products.name: The Roots Kit
products.line: Question cards, recording tips and a family-book template, so you can record your elders yourself.
products.who: Anyone who wishes they had asked sooner, and would like a gentle structure.
steps: Pick a card and ask.
Record the answer on your phone.
Keep it in your archive, or in the book.
products.trust: Joining the waitlist is one message. You will see the price before you decide.

products.name: Storytellers
products.line: A trained storyteller sits with your elder, in person or online, in their own language, and records their stories for your archive.
products.who: Families who can't ask the questions themselves, or want it done gently and well.
products.price: The storyteller's own price, plus a {{fee-percent}}% booking fee shown separately.
steps: Tell us whose stories to keep.
We introduce a storyteller who speaks their language.
The recordings arrive in your archive.
products.trust: Everything recorded goes into your family's archive, and your family owns it.

products.name: Keepsakes
products.line: Objects that carry your roots: a painting of your family's place, your roots portrait made into art, and small drops from named makers.
products.who: Anyone who wants something to hang, hold or hand down.
products.price: Each maker's own price, plus a {{fee-percent}}% fee shown separately.
steps: Choose a maker or a drop.
Tell them what it is for.
It is made for you, with its story.
products.trust: Every piece is credited to the person who made it, and their price is never hidden in ours.

products.name: Commission a piece
products.line: A painting of your family's home town or your family name in a folk-art style, made by a named artist who sets the price.
products.who: Families marking a wedding, a birthday or a homecoming.
products.price: The artist's own price, plus a {{fee-percent}}% fee shown separately.
steps: Tell us what you would like made.
The artist proposes, with a price.
They make it, and it comes with their story.
products.trust: The artist is named, sets their own price and keeps all of it.

products.name: Gifting
products.line: Gifts for festivals, weddings and family occasions from named makers, made to pre-order, each with a card that tells its story.
products.who: Anyone sending gifts that should mean something to the family receiving them.
products.price: Quoted per order, with the makers' prices shown.
steps: Tell us who the gifts are for.
We suggest makers and pieces.
They are made to order and sent with their story.
products.trust: Made to pre-order, never mass-stocked, and every maker is named.

products.name: Journeys
products.line: Go back to your family's village or town with a host who knows it, or spend a few days with a tradition and the people who keep it.
products.who: Families going back, often for the first time in generations.
products.price: Each host's own price, plus a {{fee-percent}}% booking fee. The first hosts are being invited now.
steps: Tell us what you know about the place.
We introduce a host who lives there.
Plan the visit together.
products.trust: Nothing is promised that can't be found, and hosts set their own prices.

products.name: For organisations
products.line: Roots programmes for schools, diaspora and community groups, led by makers and storytellers on the platform.
products.who: Schools, diaspora associations and community groups.
products.price: Quoted per programme, with the practitioner's fee shown separately.
steps: Tell us about your group.
We propose a session and a practitioner.
Agree a clear quote before anything is booked.
products.trust: Everything is agreed in writing before it begins.
